headword: {窮地|きゅうち}に{陥|おちい}る
gloss: to fall into a predicament; to find oneself in a tight spot

definitions.gloss: to fall into a predicament; to find oneself in a desperate situation
definitions.explanation: To end up in a very difficult or desperate situation from which it is hard to escape.

examples.japanese: {窮地|きゅうち}に{陥|おちい}った。
examples.english: I found myself in a tight spot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{窮地|きゅうち}に{陥|おちい}った。
examples.english: The company fell into a management crisis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誤|あやま}った→誤る：27433_ayamaru⟧ことで、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{窮地|きゅうち}に{陥|おちい}ってしまった。
examples.english: A misjudgment caused the entire team to fall into a desperate situation.

notes:
⟦{窮地|きゅうち}→窮地：08684_kyuuchi⟧ means a dire situation or predicament, and ⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ means to fall into. A set expression common in news and formal writing.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{窮地|きゅうち}→窮地：08684_kyuuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされる: to be driven into a corner (passive — someone else puts you there)
- ⟦{窮地|きゅうち}→窮地：08684_kyuuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|だっ}する→脱する：28650_dassuru⟧: to escape a predicament
- ⟦{窮地|きゅうち}→窮地：08684_kyuuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}む→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧: to drive someone into a corner
- ⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into crisis (similar pattern)

USAGE:
Implies a serious, difficult-to-escape situation. Stronger than ⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧ (to be troubled) and more formal than ⟦ピンチ→ピンチ：11143_pinchi⟧ (a pinch).
